title: Datastore inventory (technology-agnostic policy input)
description: Neutral description of the data stores in a system, produced by a platform adapter (e.g. Azure ARM template -> inventory) and evaluated by the policies in policies/datastores. Adapters must state every value explicitly, applying platform defaults themselves: the policies treat a missing value as non-compliant.

id.description: Stable identifier of the data store within the system (used as the subject in assessment results).

kind.description: Kind of data store, e.g. relational-database, object-store, file-share.

enabled.description: Stored data, logs and backups are encrypted with a cryptographic mechanism.
Changes to stored data are cryptographically recorded so that unauthorized modification is detectable.

source.description: Optional traceability back to the platform resource the adapter read.
